title: Naturality of termwise tensor comparisons on signed summands
statement: For four additive functors between the internal and section module categories and a natural isomorphism between their composites, the tensor of its prolonged components carries each bidegree tensor inclusion to the target inclusion after the tensor of the two corresponding ordinary components.

source.place: Tag 07A4, degreewise ordinary tensor compatibility and signed direct-sum totalization; Modules on Sites, Tags 03EK and 03EL.

proof.text: Apply GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorHom. The degree components of the prolonged comparison are definitionally the original components. The private scalar and section total formulas follow from mapBifunctorComparison on inclusions and the unique normalized total comparison, respectively.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, the ordinary comparison and the passage to unbounded total complexes.

theorem coefficientScalarTensor_summandNaturality (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (F₁ : ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z ⥤
      ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules S Z)
    (F₂ : ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules S Z ⥤ ModuleRingedComparison.modules S Z)
    (G₁ : ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z ⥤ ModuleRingedComparison.modules R Z)
    (G₂ : ModuleRingedComparison.modules R Z ⥤ ModuleRingedComparison.modules S Z)
    [F₁.Additive] [F₂.Additive] [G₁.Additive] [G₂.Additive]
    (e : F₁ ⋙ F₂ ≅ G₁ ⋙ G₂)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) ℤ)
    (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    let F₁c := F₁.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let F₂c := F₂.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G₁c := G₁.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G₂c := G₂.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let eC : F₁c ⋙ F₂c ≅ G₁c ⋙ G₂c := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (.up ℤ)
    HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj (F₂c.obj (F₁c.obj P)) (F₂c.obj (F₁c.obj Q)) p q n hpq ≫
      ((eC.hom.app P ⊗ₘ eC.hom.app Q).f n) =
    (e.hom.app (P.X p) ⊗ₘ e.hom.app (Q.X q)) ≫
      HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj (G₂c.obj (G₁c.obj P)) (G₂c.obj (G₁c.obj Q))
        p q n hpq
